facts.fact: Kasi Cloud, a Nigerian company, is stated by MoneyCentral citing various sources to have planned a US$250 million investment in its first Lekki, Lagos data centre campus (LOS1), which broke ground on 19 April 2022; the document says LOS1 was not operational by mid-2025.
facts.system: Kasi Cloud LOS1 data centre campus

note: NSIA equity (US$6m in 2024) and loans to Kasi Cloud come from a state sovereign fund, so state money and class other, not facts.
